content_md: The Inelegant Universe Hypothesis holds that AI exposes how our craving for simple, elegant beauty blinds us to the messy nature of the universe, much as the Greeks recoiled from irrational numbers, and that we can either learn to see the deeper beauty in that messiness or mourn the loss of our old gods.
